diagram_math_checks.evidence: Example Charts, Verification 1.1 and F8, and thm-affine-blowup-standard-charts Statement/Proof 2.1–4.1 identify U_x=Spec A[y/x], U_y=Spec A[x/y], W=U_x intersection U_y. Both top arrows have domain W and codomain the relevant chart and are open immersions. The overlap inverts T=y/x and U=x/y; U=T^{-1} there. The union is precisely pi^{-1}(Spec A), not all of S prime without the affine restriction.

The given definition E=pi^{-1}(p) is scheme-theoretic; def-exceptional-curve-and-contraction Remarks identifies this inverse image with the fibre product. Thus i:E->S prime and j:Spec k->S are closed immersions, q:E->Spec k is the structural map, and pi:S prime->S satisfies pi composed i = j composed q. The square is Cartesian; the bottom Spec k is valid because p is explicitly k-rational.

The Example and Given explicitly impose k-rationality; hence kappa(p)=k and E is P1_k. Verification 2.1, lem-exceptional-curve-normal-bundle-minus-one Proof 2.1–3.1 and thm-blowup-regular-surface-closed-point-regular Proof 2.1/4.2 give the two affine-line fibre pieces, reciprocal transition and O_E(E)=O_P1_k(-1). E dot E=-1 in the caption remains conditional on S projective over k, as in the original Example. For a general closed point the suppliers instead give P1 over kappa(p), normal degree -1 over that field and k-intersection -[kappa(p):k]; no general-point assertion was added.

Verification 3.1 and lem-blowup-isomorphism-off-center Statement give pi:S prime minus E -> S minus {p} as an isomorphism. The unchanged numbered verification establishes all asserted properties independently; the new diagram is only its summary. The contraction supplier is used only in its unchanged forward direction, not its separately corrected converse.
